authority.subject: Author-delegated VCSF configuration adjudication and final-background ablation standard

criterion: Primary attacked BB AP takes priority within the original 23 registered configurations and their own declared schedules; preserve each control setting rather than replacing the complete family with the nominee schedule.

Nominate A10 using full-panel primary ranking, direct alternative comparisons, descriptive target/family composition sensitivity and existing nested-layer evidence; none of these establish global or cross-seed optimality.
Accept the observed YOLO-family and some small/medium-object or recall tradeoffs for this overall-AP objective; disclose them rather than voting across correlated secondary metrics.
A real pre-existing resource or budget violation can block execution. Additional feature terms or an ordinary measured timing difference alone do not invent a new veto threshold.

Final scientific freeze additionally requires adequate final-background evidence for the actual paper claims, exact implementation qualification and accepted cost/input provenance. Contradictory core evidence triggers recorded reconsideration, not automatic fallback or silent method splicing.

not_added: new AP seed grid absent a specific decision-relevant uncertainty

later_contradiction_rule: Record a dated reconsideration and refresh affected identity and results; no silent post-main-table switching.
next_gates: Qualify the exact public A10 parameter mapping, numerical path, full source identity and bounded real-model behavior in fixed ODA.
Decide exact reuse of each accepted Common-2 payload and result through a separately accepted identity bridge; do not rename results.
Admit and independently accept only the genuinely affected final-method results and required current cost/qualitative evidence.
Integrate final-identity tables, attribution, negative outcomes and selection explanation into the paper before closing submission selection.

rationale: Select the complete registered A10 configuration, not a splice. The complete Faster-source family has no lower primary BB AP configuration under the declared retrospective rule.

Exact A10-background controls support the paired-view construction and budgeted detector-plus-feature schedule. Layer, energy and aggregation choices are tied to their tested background, not relabeled A01 ablations.

The Faster backbone-only F03 counterexample is material and retained, including all twelve BB summaries. The pre-Swin equal-source supplement supports the joint design only against that alternative, not a two-source all23 optimum.

Bounded paired A01/A10/A23 time and memory measurements do not establish equal physical cost or a significant advantage; they provide no resource veto against A10. Unknown F03 calibrated physical cost remains unknown.
A01 and A23 are preserved as historical identities. Their accepted efficacy, seed or cross-dataset results cannot be inherited by A10.

selected_numerical_implementation_identi.legacy_run_implementation_field: alias-derived label; actual builder and original runtime snapshot govern source identity

selection_scope: Full original 23-configuration Faster R-CNN val2017 source-excluded AP ranking and setting rationale, followed by a pre-Swin equal-source A10/F03 check addressing the specific adverse backbone-only alternative. This is not a common two-source ranking of all23 or a cross-source/seed/global optimum.
two_source_rule: Compare A10 and F03 on the same full-val images within each source, then compare their equal-weight two-source source-excluded BB Mean. This criterion was set after observing the Faster F03 result but before the new Swin result; small differences remain descriptive, not stable superiority.
